checked_scope: Positive one-good equilibrium, financing-sensitive real versus nominal multipliers, and the sharp conditional price-output curve.
checks: Solved nominal clearing pY=Y0*r and positive supply pY=Y0*p^(1+epsilon); uniqueness holds even at epsilon=0.
Checked individual nominal plans depend on Y0*r rather than the supply elasticity, so their nonnegativity cannot be repaired by varying elasticity. Summing real plans closes goods accounting.
Differentiated real Y at B=0 to get epsilon*Bprime/[(1+epsilon)(1-cbar)], separating it from the nominal multiplier. Domestic financing uses Bprime=mr-mt.
Verified all admissible price-output pairs lie on pY=Y0*r, with opposite coordinate extrema when r>1. A noiseless p>1 identifies epsilon=log(r)/log(p)-1, whereas baseline r=1 cannot.
